name: Ōshikōchi no Mitsune
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 29); Porter’s note gives the dates as: early 10th century.

poems.title: It was a white chrysanthemum
poems.author: Ōshikōchi no Mitsune
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 29
poems.text:
It was a white chrysanthemum
I came to take away;
But, which are coloured, which are white,
I’m half afraid to say,
So thick the frost to-day!

poems.title: 29. 心あてに 折らばや折らむ 初霜の (Kokoro ate ni orabaya oramu hatsushimo no)
poems.author: Ōshikōchi no Mitsune
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
心あてに 折らばや折らむ 初霜の
置きまどはせる 白菊の花
